plugins.name: ai-transformation
plugins.description: A suite of skills for leading AI transformation in a firm or function: an advisor that finds and plans AI opportunities (onboarding, a guided loop from framing to a sequenced plan, unit breakdown and roll-up, acquisition assessment), plus skills to run the AI portfolio, take solutions to production, run enablement and adoption, and set practical governance. Built on researched, fact-checked knowledge of professional services, assurance, tax, advisory and security, with honest handling of how roles change.
